svg.text: The heavy wheel is hard to start, so
water takes the easy path through the reducer.
The wheel is at full speed and barely resists,
so the water prefers the wheel path.
The spinning wheel cannot stop at once.
It keeps pushing water around the loop.
Pump = battery · Pipes = wires · Reducer = resistance · Heavy wheel = inductor
The wheel’s momentum is like the inductor’s magnetic field: it resists any sudden change in the flow.
